run_cal_train_time: run cal_train_time to analyze average training time per iteration from JSON logs
run_plot_curve: run plot_curve to plot training metrics like bbox_mAP from JSON logs as a curve
run_load_json_logs: run load_json_logs to parse JSON training logs into a dictionary keyed by epoch
run_parse_args: run parse_args to parse command line arguments for plot_curve or cal_train_time tasks
run_main: run main to analyze JSON logs by plotting curves or calculating training time
